bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; a=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE board_key='area_bbs' AND purpose='announcement' AND chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND (enabled=FALSE OR verified_at IS NULL OR verified_by IS NULL)" 2>/dev/null) || exit 90; b=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND state IN ('needs_reconcile','publishing')" 2>/dev/null) || exit 91; test "$a" -le 5 && test "$b" -le 5 || exit 92; exit $((100+a+10*b))
